response.speaker: Enyashi Yukari
response.text: Ah, about that. I believe the Lady Guuji must've given you a stack of fortune slip paper, right?

response.speaker: Enyashi Yukari
response.text: You just need to hold the fortune slip with both hands, think about the wish you want realized, then write it down on said slip...

response.speaker: Enyashi Yukari
response.text: Finally, stick the paper onto a Prayer Plaque and hang it on the Prayer Rack.

response.speaker: Enyashi Yukari
response.text: Don't worry, I won't peek at your wish! The reason I'm here is... Well, I'm also in charge of cleaning up around here, so...

response.speaker: Enyashi Yukari
response.text: I've just started working here, so simple tasks are all I'm currently allowed to do.

response.speaker: Enyashi Yukari
response.text: Ah...! Sorry, I was just running my mouth, wasn't I? Sorry for taking up your time. Just do what you need to do... I've still got some tidying up to do.

response.speaker: Enyashi Yukari
response.text: See you again. May your wishes come true.
